title: Verify: Contribution service validation unit tests
summary: Unit tests proving the service rejects invalid submissions before anything is written.
description: Unit tests written from the requirement spec with mocked Git, clock and temp-dir filesystem only. Context: the service rejects invalid submissions before anything is written. Expected result: all listed tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: Given a prompt shorter than MinPromptLen or longer than MaxPromptLen, when Submit runs, then ErrPromptLength is returned
Given a world with no round source entry, when Submit runs, then ErrWorldNotFound is returned
Given a round whose status is not OPEN, when Submit runs, then ErrRoundNotOpen is returned
Given a player with 5 stored contributions in the round, when Submit runs, then ErrLimitReached is returned
Given more than RateMax submissions in RateWindow by one player, when Submit runs, then ErrRateLimited is returned
Given a prompt identical (case/whitespace-insensitive) to the player's earlier one or containing 10+ repeated identical characters, when Submit runs, then ErrDuplicate or ErrSpam is returned

preserve: Existing player session handlers in backend/internal/player

technical_constraints: Go 1.22, chi router, no database; persistent data lives in Git as Markdown/YAML
Git writes go through an interface wrapping the Git CLI
definition_of_done: Listed tests pass via the unit command

steps.action: Write test TestSubmit_Rejects: table test with fake RoundSource, fake Store and fixed clock: prompt of 2 and 501 runes -> ErrPromptLength; unknown world -> ErrWorldNotFound; round Status CLOSED -> ErrRoundNotOpen; CountByPlayer returns 5 -> ErrLimitReached; HasPrompt true -> ErrDuplicate; prompt with 11 'a' -> ErrSpam; assert Store.Save call count is 0 each time.
Write test TestSubmit_RateLimit: fixed clock; 4th submit within RateWindow -> ErrRateLimited; advance clock past window -> success.
Write test TestSubmit_OK: valid input returns Contribution with CreatedAt equal to the fixed clock and Save called once.
